error.title: This card fell out of the binder
error.body: We couldn't load it. Your collection is safe.

noResults.title: Not here (yet)
noResults.body: If it exists, suggest it and the community will review it.

cameraDenied.title: We can't scan without the camera
cameraDenied.body: You can turn it on in Settings or choose a photo you already have: we'll crop it just the same.

cardSheet.title: Card
cardSheet.notFound: This card is no longer in the catalog
cardSheet.turnHint: Drag to turn it. Tap to flip it.

hint.none: Mark it to keep track of your collection.
hint.have: You have it. If you have a spare, mark it as Dupe.
hint.want: We'll let you know when someone has a spare.
hint.dupe: People looking for it will see it in their matches.

empty.title: Your binder is empty
empty.body: Create one by group, member or era and start filling pockets.

options.title: Binder options
options.name: Name
options.confirmBody: Your Have and Want marks are kept.

binder.moveHint: Press and hold a card, then drag it to another pocket.

collect.title: Collect
collect.body: Your digital binder, with your own photos inside every pocket.

mark.title: Mark Have and Want
mark.body: One tap. No market prices or rankings.

match.title: We'll find your match
match.body: When someone has what you want and wants what you have.

welcome.body: Your photocard collection, sorted in your binder and ready to trade.

place.title: Where do you live?
place.body: Just country and {term}, so we can find trades near you. We never use your exact location.

dob.title: When were you born?
dob.body: We use it to protect minors: under 18 means a private profile, limited chat and quiet hours. Nobody else sees it.
dob.min: You need to be at least {age}.

blocked.title: You can't use Binku yet
blocked.body: Binku is for people aged {age} or over. We haven't saved any data. See you soon!

groups.title: Your groups
groups.body: Pick one or more. Then your bias.

ready.body: Tap a pocket or press Scan to add your first card.

email.title: Keep your collection safe
email.body: Create an account to sync your binder across phones and find matches.
email.label: Your email
email.legal: By continuing you accept the community rules and the privacy policy.
email.signInBody: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a code to sign in.

code.title: Check your email
code.label: 6-digit code
code.help: No passwords to remember. Not there? Check spam or promotions.

username.title: Pick your @username
username.body: This is how other collectors see you when you match. You can change it later.
username.label: Username
username.rules: 3 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot or underscore.

errors.offline: No connection. Try again when you're online.
errors.rateLimit: Too many codes requested. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.badCode: Wrong or expired code. Check the latest email or ask for a new one.
errors.taken: That @username is taken. Try another one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.captcha: We couldn't confirm you're not a robot. Wait for the green tick and try again.

upload.title: Hi, @{username}!
upload.body: You had a binder saved on this phone without an account. Shall we upload it?

export.title: Export my data
export.body: Choose a format. The share menu will open so you can save or send it.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.confirmBody: Your account is hidden now and fully deleted in 14 days, with your binders and marks. Signing in again before then cancels it.
delete.doneBody: It will be deleted on {date}. If you change your mind, sign in with your email before then.
delete.cancelledBody: You had asked to delete your account. Since you signed in again, we're keeping it.

signOutPending.title: Changes not uploaded yet
signOutPending.body: We couldn't upload some changes (are you offline?). If you sign out now, they will be lost.

scan.title: Three tricks for a perfect shot

tipDark.title: Dark, plain background
tipDark.body: A table or a black folder: the card's edge is found by itself.

tipLight.title: Soft light, no flash
tipLight.body: Next to a window, out of direct sun.

tipShine.title: Shiny? Tilt it a little
tipShine.body: That keeps glare off holo and glossy cards.

scan.privacyAsk: We'll ask for the camera. The photo is processed on your phone and only uploaded when you save it.
scan.privacy: The photo is processed on your phone and only uploaded when you save it.

unavailable.title: This phone has no scanner
unavailable.body: Google's document scanner is missing. Choose a photo from your gallery: we'll crop it just the same.

review.title: Check the crop
review.none: Choose which card it is to save it.
review.error: We couldn't save the photo. Please try again.
review.blocked: This image doesn't follow Binku's rules. Use a photo of your photocard.
review.galleryRule: Only photos of your own photocards. Any other image is removed and may get your account suspended.

home.noneBody: Mark cards as Want and Spare: we'll let you know when someone fits.
home.firstBinderBody: Pick a group, member or era and fill the pockets.

matches.title: Matches
matches.note: Ranked by match and distance. Never by price.
matches.offline: Offline: this list may be out of date.
matches.needAccount: Create an account to see matches
matches.intlBody: International shipping takes longer, costs more and may carry customs fees. Binku is not involved in shipping or payments.
matches.gone: This match is no longer available.
matches.tipAddress: Don't share your address in the chat.
matches.tipPayments: The app is not involved in payments or shipping.
matches.step1: Propose the trade by chat and agree on the details.
matches.step2: Send the cards, ideally with tracking.
matches.step3: Confirm they arrived and rate each other: your cards update by themselves.

alerts.title: Match alerts
alerts.matchesBody: We tell you right away when someone has what you want and wants something of yours. Never ads.
alerts.denied: Binku isn't allowed to notify you. Turn it on in your phone's settings.
alerts.error: We couldn't save the change. Check your connection.
alerts.quietBody: Alerts that arrive during these hours wait until they end.
alerts.messagesBody: When someone writes to you. The text never shows on the lock screen.

photo.title: Your photo
photo.removeBody: It's deleted from this phone and your account. The card stays marked.
photo.quota: This photo is only on your phone: you already have 1,000 cards with a photo in the cloud.
photo.noAccount: Only on this phone. It will upload when you create your account.
photo.conditionBody: As is, no filters or edits. Shown when you offer this card.
photo.from: Where should the photo come from?

demo.title: You are trying Binku
demo.body: Without an account Binku is a demo: whatever you add is erased when the app closes. Create an account or sign in to keep your collection.

offer.title: Offer for
offer.needsPhoto: To offer it, add the front photo first.
offer.priceHint: Only shown on this card sheet. Never in lists or matches.
offer.priceShown: {price} · only shown on this card sheet.

chat.title: Messages
chat.emptyBody: Propose a trade from a match and the conversation will show up here.
chat.retention: Chats are deleted 90 days after the last message.
chat.tip: Don't share your address or phone number here. Tracked shipping recommended.
chat.structured: With under-18s only proposals and cards can be sent. It keeps everyone safe.
chat.proposeMatchBody: Your spares they want, for their spares you want.
chat.startBody: Say hi or send the proposal. @{username} will get a notification.
chat.reportBody: Only the Binku team sees it.
chat.blockBody: They can't write to you or show up in your matches.
chat.muteBody: You still get messages, without a notification.
chat.blockConfirm: They can't write to you or appear in your matches. We don't tell them.
chat.reportIntro: What happened? Only the Binku team will see the report and the messages of this conversation. @{username} won't know it was you.

reason.personal_data: Asks for or shares personal data

chat.reported: Thanks. We'll review the report as soon as we can.

err.blocked: You can't write to this user.
err.unavailable: This user is no longer available.
err.tooManyChats: You've started many conversations today. Try again tomorrow.
err.slowDown: You're going too fast. Wait a moment.
err.structured: With under-18s only proposals and cards can be sent.
err.phone: Don't share phone numbers in the chat.
err.email: Don't share emails in the chat.
err.address: Don't share addresses in the chat.
err.link: Links can't be sent to under-18s.
err.handle: Other social networks can't be shared with under-18s.
err.insult: This message doesn't follow Binku's rules.
err.tooManyReports: You've sent many reports today. Try again tomorrow.
